world.name: The Outskirts
world.blurb: The Outskirts: one continuous road with 14 checkpointed challenges, ending in a superroom.
world.outro: The Outskirts, end to end, without leaving the road.

keepsake.name: Rowan’s Bell
keepsake.gives: Rowan hangs it at Camp Echo. In the Fractured Outskirts it still rings: it opens Rowan’s echo.

keepsake.name: Mara’s Chart
keepsake.gives: All three bearings agree, and the tunnel to the woods goes on her map. In the Fractured Outskirts the chart opens Mara’s echo.

rooms.name: The Verge Road
rooms.question: Two beds of white flowers and a bank. How high, and how far, does one jump go?

people.line: Fire’s for anyone. Just don’t touch the white flowers.

rooms.name: The Poisoned Verge
rooms.hint: A dash crosses what a jump cannot
rooms.question: The pool is wider than any jump. What else carries you?

people.line: Oh! Hello. Mara, surveyor. Three posts off this road: Ash, Glass, Iron. Touch them for me?

rooms.name: White Flowers
rooms.hint: Hold grab against a wall to cling and climb
rooms.question: The wall is taller than any jump. What do your hands do?

rooms.name: Camp Echo
rooms.hint: A survey stake lights when you touch it · every stake lit opens the shaft
rooms.question: The shaft is shut. What up on the perch would open it?

people.line: Came up the west road? Huh. Touch the stake on the perch.
Gate’s shut. You got through anyway. Bell’s up the east tower.
people.lineDone: There. Now we’ll hear them coming.

rooms.name: The Lookout
rooms.hint: Jump off a wall you cling to · white flowers grow on the walls too
rooms.question: Two walls, and poison on each. Which wall does each stretch belong to?

rooms.name: Watcher’s Cut
rooms.hint: A crystal grows back a moment after you take it
rooms.question: One crystal is not enough to cross the cut. Where can you get another?

people.line: Clock’s stopped. The cut’s worse. Only the glass in the air holds.

rooms.name: Cracked Road
rooms.hint: Cracked stone gives way a moment after you stand on it
rooms.question: Nothing here holds for long. How long is long enough?

rooms.name: The Hollow Mile
rooms.hint: Cracked stone comes back a while after it falls
rooms.question: The road is cracked the whole way. How long can you stand anywhere?

rooms.name: Broken Muster
rooms.hint: Climb, then let go and fall to the stake
rooms.question: The muster gate is shut. What would the post on the old wall open?

people.line: Made it. Any bearings for me?
people.lineDone: Ash, Glass, Iron. They agree. The road goes through.

rooms.name: Muster Yard
rooms.hint: Everything the road has taught, in one breath
rooms.question: Cracked stone, a crystal, the yard wall. In what order, and with what left in hand?

rooms.name: The Gatehouse
rooms.hint: Grab carries the lantern; grab again throws it · a plate holds its door open while something rests on it
rooms.question: The gate only stays up while the plate is pressed. What can press it for you?

rooms.name: The Bell Yard
rooms.hint: A stake opens the tower door
rooms.question: The tower door is shut, and the stake is over the flowers. What still holds up there?

rooms.name: The Old Bell Tower
rooms.hint: Cracked ledges fall · the bell is at the top; out through the belfry
rooms.question: Cracked ledges on both walls. Which ones will still be there on the way up?

rooms.name: Passing Places
rooms.hint: The deep pockets lie below the patrol. Let it pass over you before climbing back out.
rooms.question: When should you follow the thorns, and when should you let them pass?

rooms.name: Wait Below the Lip
rooms.hint: The outer ends of the ledges are safe. Watch the crossing and the landing before you commit.
rooms.question: Does the patrol leave enough room to finish your landing?

rooms.name: Leave the Lift for Later
rooms.hint: The bearing raises the lift’s upper stop. Ride outward, light it, then return underneath the old route.
rooms.question: The bearing opens the gate home. Where will the same lift take you on the return?

rooms.name: Rootwater Descent
rooms.hint: Follow the river beneath the roots.

people.name: Root tender
people.line: The Keep’s water finds its way down here. Follow the pale roots; they drink from the same river.

rooms.name: Pilgrims’ Viaduct
rooms.hint: The broken road crosses the old valley. The undercroft offers a way back up.
